title: Web Filtering
description: Access to external websites should be managed and restricted to reduce exposure to malicious content, unauthorized web resources, and inappropriate material that could compromise systems or data.

title: Use Of Cryptography
description: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, should be defined and implemented to protect the confidentiality, integrity, authenticity, and non-repudiation of information.

title: Secure Development Life Cycle
description: Rules for the secure development of software and systems should be established and applied throughout the entire development life cycle, from planning and design through to deployment and maintenance.

title: Application Security Requirements
description: Information security requirements should be identified, specified, and approved when developing or acquiring applications, so that security is built in rather than added on afterward.

title: Secure System Architecture And Engineering Principles
description: Principles for engineering secure systems should be established, documented, maintained, and applied to any information system development activity, covering both new builds and ongoing changes.

title: Secure Coding
description: Secure coding principles should be applied to software development to reduce the number of potential security vulnerabilities introduced into code before it is deployed.

title: Security Testing In Development And Acceptance
description: Security testing processes should be defined and implemented within the development life cycle, including at acceptance stages, to verify that security requirements have been met before systems go live.

title: Outsourced Development
description: Organizations should direct, monitor, and review the activities involved in outsourced system development to ensure that externally developed software and systems meet the organization's security requirements.

title: Separation Of Development, Test And Production Environments
description: Development, testing, and production environments should be separated and secured to reduce the risk of unauthorized access, unintended changes, or disruption to live systems and data.

title: Change Management
description: Changes to information processing facilities and information systems should be subject to formal change management procedures to control and record modifications and minimize the risk of disruption.

title: Test Information
description: Test data used during development, testing, and evaluation of systems should be appropriately selected, protected, and managed, particularly to avoid the inappropriate use of real production data.

title: Protection Of Information Systems During Audit Testing
description: Audit tests and other assurance activities involving the assessment of operational systems should be planned and agreed upon between the tester and appropriate management to minimize disruption to business processes.
